scope: Coordinator-only source-based cross-worker dependency and zero-regression gate planning
ci_scope_note: Worker-specific Text Center tests succeeded at their earlier worker heads. Current coordinator PR #82 workflow run 43119633429 FAILED at head d3f9dffd... from stale zero-worker assertions; this is separate from original satellite PR #37 source-vs-Pages parity failure and from any physical hardware acceptance.
permission_boundary: This phase may inspect and commit only coordinator documentation. Changing source, installers, repos, logos, workflows, release, deployment, user SDR services or main requires separate owner approval.

gate_status_vocabulary.OPEN: Evidence and acceptance gates remain open; no code change authorized
gate_status_vocabulary.DOC_EVIDENCE_READY: Source and proposed test description recorded, not tested
gate_status_vocabulary.CI_VERIFIED: Specific workflow + SHA and log passed only in its declared scope
gate_status_vocabulary.HARDWARE_VERIFIED: Physical device run evidence, as supported

gates.title: Preserve Media stacked #65→#66→#67 source history
gates.observed: The documentation branch descends from #66 but the unmerged #67 recording/export head contains 20 additional commits and source/test files. The overlap of three source paths is not proof of a textual conflict.
gates.document_only_next: Create an immutable eight-path PR #67 delta inventory with blob SHA, test and original discussion links. Cross-reference Media #65/#66 ancestry and expected export modes without copying app code.
gates.acceptance_proof: Later separately approved integration must show selected code+tests retain #67 recording/export capability and old Media features, compare rollback and FFmpeg output on isolated sample recordings, and prevent accidental overwrite of user files.
gates.approval_required_for: Selecting a migration source tree, resolving or applying code changes, merging or writing to new Media repository.

gates.title: Protect current Text Center main against three stale archive blobs
gates.observed: Retained main source differs from the old audit snapshot for textcenter/compute.py, textcenter/speech.py and textcenter/transcripts.py. A snapshot is not an authoritative current Text Center baseline. Verified three active-vs-archived Text source blob divergences; archived compute/speech/transcripts introduce GPU readiness, language, audio and translator changes plus sibling tv_center imports. Pinned original main blobs remain unchanged.
gates.document_only_next: Pin current main and worker SHA/blob pairs, map behavioral/contract differences and distinguish historical snapshots from active source. No restore, rebase or cherry-pick.
gates.acceptance_proof: Later isolated comparison of current active UI/API/transcript output, files, settings and URLs; preserve unchanged main unless a distinct authorized feature PR passes parity.
gates.approval_required_for: Any change to current main, Text Center runtime or archive replacement.

gates.title: Exclusive receiver and external readsb ownership
gates.observed: Flight main close(release_local_service=True) may stop pre-existing shared readsb; Draft Flight PR #7 instead tracks app ownership. RF-only OFF behavior in Geolocation does not prove device lease release. A global Hard Stop contract is not verified.
gates.document_only_next: Write a cross-app device-owner state table for external/app-started/direct receivers, RF On/Off, explicit Stop, application close, failure, service restart and sudo-denied outcomes.
gates.acceptance_proof: On an owner-approved isolated Pop!_OS SDR session, record pre/post active readsb/tar1090/gqrx/welle processes, RTL-SDR lease and safe failure outcomes. Non-owned services must remain running; on-demand default preserved.
gates.approval_required_for: Hardware session that changes live services, runtime receiver lifecycle code, privileged setup or shared installations.

gates.title: Resolve Flight three-versus-four RF aircraft draft semantics
gates.observed: Flight canonical main models an upper-bound feasible area with >=3 RF ICAOs; Draft PR #13 requires >=4 independent ICAOs and five distinct history models. Neither is a precise receiver GPS fix.
gates.document_only_next: Record user-facing observed main vs draft contract in a decision table: 3 vs 4, independent ICAO validity, LIVE10/LIVE-X/BEST/HISTORY/HISTORY BEST, uncertainty and RF provenance; propose tests per mode.
gates.acceptance_proof: Only after a separately approved specification and review, compare real RF records with replayed/synthetic geometry, including Internet spoof exclusion, permutation invariance, no center-as-GPS, expected persistence and fallback.
gates.approval_required_for: Changing algorithm thresholds, model UI, histories or promoting Draft #13 to released behavior.

gates.title: Scientific gate for independent geolocation, timestamps and confidence
gates.observed: ADS-B aircraft coordinates and RSSI radius hypotheses do not provide independent receiver self-location, calibrated TDOA, GNSS-SDR pseudorange PVT or statistically validated PSF/Gaussian covariance.
gates.document_only_next: Inventory required independent receiver stations, hardware timebase/synchronization, timestamps, measured ranges, calibration datasets, uncertainty model and confidence provenance. Mark unavailable conditions explicitly.
gates.acceptance_proof: Independent calibrated measurement corpus with ground-truth receiver location, timing provenance, uncertainty calibration and no false location claims; native GNSS acquisition/PVT separately verified if available.
gates.approval_required_for: New positioning implementation, hardware capture, location-accuracy claims or installation of native GNSS backend.

gates.title: Resolve Satellite recording-rate versus Meteor decoder rate
gates.observed: Native scheduling permits sample_rate 1024000 or 2048000, but decode_meteor() forwards fixed SatDump --samplerate 1024000 for the recording. No lossless 2.048 MS/s decode acceptance is proved.
gates.document_only_next: Record capture metadata contract (Hz, CU8, duration, UTC, original path) and SatDump argv across each supported rate; propose fixture tests for correct-rate forwarding, unsupported-rate rejection and preservation of input data.
gates.acceptance_proof: Reproducible known-rate IQ fixture and owner-approved real Meteor dataset demonstrate decoder receives correct sample rate, no fabricated images, original IQ preserved and correct empty-CADU/error classification.
gates.approval_required_for: Decoder argument changes, real receiver collection, sample conversion or decoder installation.

gates.title: Make long Satellite chained-capture gaps explicit
gates.observed: Browser segmented capture defaults to a 6-second interpart budget and native chains reserve 21–60-second restart windows. A separate bounded native single-file capture path exists; there is no proof all chained captures are gapless.
gates.document_only_next: Specify manifest-level segment start/end UTC, missing-sample/coverage flag, rate, loss boundaries and no-overwrite ownership; compare browser and native semantics.
gates.acceptance_proof: After approval, safe fixture file-segment checks and physical recording verify uninterrupted intervals only where actually supported; UI must disclose gaps, never claim lossless chained reception by default.
gates.approval_required_for: Changing capture scheduler, hardware device acquisition, browser/WebUSB behavior or existing recording files.

gates.title: Satellite Pages/source deployment parity failure
gates.observed: The original satellite PR #37 CI run 42559046861 failed a Pages/source parity check for eight browser assets, despite separate portable synthetic jobs succeeding.
gates.document_only_next: Preserve eight failing asset names and source/current Pages blob SHA manifest, differentiate review branch vs public URLs and capture intended deployment/rollback steps as a future checklist.
gates.acceptance_proof: Post-approval review of all expected hashes, public Pages HTTP paths, PWA/service worker cache, URLs, offline operation and source revision markers at both retained and new publication sites.
gates.approval_required_for: Any Pages publish, workflow/source write, CDN/PWA change, repo rename or installer URL repoint.

gates.title: Satellite independent branch test provenance and 11-item candidate gap correction
gates.observed: Initial coordinator index identifies 11 without local test-file candidates. Satellite PR #37 contains 22 relevant test sources absent from the WS03 starting branch; presence there does not mean tested or transferred. Flight 016/017 lack direct candidates.
gates.document_only_next: Publish a branch-aware source/test provenance index distinguishing baseline candidates, PR #37 additional tests, executed CI, hardware tests, policy gates and actual absence. Avoid overwriting initial candidate map without a documented reconciliation.
gates.acceptance_proof: Each gap labeled either source/test linked with SHA plus genuine execution, future test required, or policy/manual gate; never infer 97 tested from 97 mapped.
gates.approval_required_for: Copying test source into active branches, workflow changes, implementing tests that write to application trees or source migrations.

gates.title: Text Center native DVB/FM/DAB claims versus passive relays and missing Journaline
gates.observed: Retained Text Center has partial FM RDS and read-only welle-cli DAB metadata bridge, but Journaline is unimplemented; passive DVB diagnostic/upstream MPEG-TS relay does not demonstrate native off-air tuner/Teletext scan. Media native source is distinct. Text archive transcripts.py has a module-level tv_center.language_codes import; archived compute.py and speech.py also reference tv_center modules. A separate Media repo cutover could break retained Text snapshot if imported dependencies disappear; classify mandatory/optional import graph before any cutover.
gates.document_only_next: Build a source-of-truth capability matrix per native Media, retained Text, external decoder, browser, actual hardware, UI claim and fallback. Preserve existing behavior without copying Media semantics into Text.
gates.acceptance_proof: Later owner-authorized real Hauppauge scan/lock/Teletext and NooElec RDS/DAB DLS/MOT sessions with labels and failure outputs; include mixed TV/radio device ownership, timestamps, actual hardware path and original user settings.
gates.approval_required_for: Changing source/native bridge, controlling tuner, installing dependencies, claiming Journaline or native Text TV feature completeness.

gates.title: Immutable GitHub history and provenance gaps
gates.observed: Two 67-entry origin history ledgers omit original PRs #72–#74; eight Flight #13 PR comment permalinks and eleven satellite Issue #20/#21 comments are linked, but full review/timeline reconciliation and verified author/time details remain incomplete. Historical PRs #72→#73→#74 form a verified ancestor chain (4 then 6 commits, both ahead/0 behind). Both 67-entry archive ledgers omit these links; source originals remain open Draft and are not lost.
gates.document_only_next: Prepare a per-original-record manifest by immutable repo ID and source PR/Issue/review/comment permalink; add missing #72–#74 history, preserve null timestamps, and explicitly list non-exportable or inaccessible evidence.
gates.acceptance_proof: A reviewer can follow all historical links and verify original source ancestry, authors/comments/review context without false recreated approvals, without private chat dumps and with explicit transfer gaps.
gates.approval_required_for: Rewriting archives in active repos, copying private content, restructuring original PRs, migrating Git history or renaming repos.

gates.title: Dual GitHub Pages, PWA, raw installers and rename-safe links
gates.observed: Flight standalone and Text mirror gh-pages revision blobs and seven sampled assets matched at a pinned Flight main SHA, but live HTTP/CDN/PWA parity is unverified. Origin workflow contains hardcoded previous repo URLs and satellite Pages asset drift is documented.
gates.document_only_next: Produce a URL and immutable-source SHA checklist: current Flight independent and Text mirror Pages, every service-worker scope, old raw install URL, asset digest, OAuth/WebUSB origin boundary, archive and redirect, with before/after expected outcomes.
gates.acceptance_proof: Only after separate rename/cutover approval, verify live status and redirects, 404/cache offline fallback, two-source revision equivalence, old one-line installer/0.3.1 rollback and PWA behavior under both origins.
gates.approval_required_for: Rename, move, delete, republish Pages, rewrite workflows/service worker, change installer or default site.

gates.title: EN(default)/TR/DE runtime UI and five approved logo binary evidence
gates.observed: All five user-facing interfaces require English default with Turkish/German options, but full installed UI path/localization tests are not complete. Approval manifest lists five PNG SHA256 values; worker did not independently rehash binary assets. No replacement logos are authorized.
gates.document_only_next: Inventory current UI strings, unsupported locale/default/fallback coverage, existing assets and source asset hashes without adding icons, online images or translations to application trees.
gates.acceptance_proof: Under separate UI/branding approval, per-platform visual+accessibility locale switching, persistence, fallback, full RTL/non-RTL behavior and exact binary SHA256 proofs for approved assets; old UI and rollback still match.
gates.approval_required_for: Adding/changing UI translations, activating/changing icons, new SVG variants, installer branding or releases.

gates.title: Native installs, portable packages and versioned rollback across five apps
gates.observed: Audited portable/synthetic CI is not a measured Windows/macOS/Linux/Raspberry Pi installed application parity result; Flight legacy 0.3.1, native installers, user settings/data and source histories must remain preserved. Three destination repos are not yet cut over.
gates.document_only_next: Write a platform-by-platform proposed build/smoke/rollback/backup matrix and request explicit approval boundary for repo first commits, source staging, platform installer updates, merges and releases.
gates.acceptance_proof: After separate authorization, signed version pin, build hashes, native smoke/hardware parity, settings+user-recording backup restore, rollback checks on each supported platform; no release without critical gate closure.
gates.approval_required_for: First commit to empty target, original repo rename, migration, installer/release changes, merges or service permission modifications.

gates.title: Evidence quality and truthful completion/ETA accounting
gates.observed: 97/97 requirements had initial source-based audits; no worker directly executed tests or physical RF/DVB sessions. Six worker PR heads had successful Text Center tests GitHub Actions, distinct from failed original satellite PR #37 Pages parity. None is a five-app installed acceptance certificate. Coordinator PR #82 head d3f9dffd CI run 43119633429 is red because two planning tests still assert zero workers after six independent report/evidence commits; do not reset true progress to zero. A narrowly scoped stage-aware coordination-test maintenance proposal has been written without changing the currently red Python tests; verify worker evidence and never reset six true audits to zero.
gates.document_only_next: Separate source-reviewed, partial draft-coded, unit/CI executed, hardware-verified, released and original requirement-completeness claims in progress. Require reproducible run IDs, exact SHA and logs before promoting any gate. Document the failing assertions and propose staged milestone checks for a later separately approved coordination-test change, preserving zero-runtime safety guards.
gates.acceptance_proof: Every critical gate gets evidence URL, exact SHA, reproducible result/runner/device or explicit unknown. ETA hours/minutes remain null until scoped tasks, environments, blocked dependencies and measured effort are present.
gates.approval_required_for: Claiming release or changing scope, running user-host hardware tests or applying code.

open_ci_contract_drift.cause: Two fixed zero-worker assertions in coordination-only metadata tests are obsolete now that six source-audit reports are verified; no actual hardware or runtime regression established

gates.title: Media Teletext/Whisper/lyrics and GPU caption-timing no-regression
gates.observed: Media source paths include Teletext matching, subtitle offset scheduler, Qwen fallback, lyrics and native hardware UI. Most existing test-source contracts are static or mock/fixture; no worker ran real TV/radio, fullscreen, karaoke alignment, 10-second buffer or RTX/CPU/NPU model parity trials.
gates.document_only_next: Construct a source-origin, timing and failure-state test contract: priority among DVB Teletext/DAB DLS/Whisper/lyrics; mismatch fallback; a single offset application; silence/music handling; local full-file prepass and video/audio player persistence; optional GPU/remote fallback never masks spoken text.
gates.acceptance_proof: Later explicit approval to run isolated timed speech/lyrics fixtures, then native TV/radio and user-provided sample media playback with traceable word/cue clocks, synchronized offset, independent karaoke/manual controls and no repeated buffering, cross-language subtitle fallback and safe model selection. Separate real hardware evidence required.
gates.approval_required_for: Editing timing, alignment, model/backend selection, translation, receiver selection, installed local AI dependencies or user playback settings.

gates.title: Canonical developer-agent and feature/component/model matrix parity
gates.observed: Flight main has substantive AGENTS.md but not independently canonical root CLAUDE.md, DEEPSEEK_START.md or FEATURE/COMPONENT/MODEL/DEVELOPMENT_AGENT JSON matrices and original source-gap documents. Origin-side matrix snapshots must not be mistaken for Flight-owned files.
gates.document_only_next: Inventory expected and actually present agent entrypoints and matrices in each of five canonical code bases, with owning repository ID and branch SHA; document schema validity, cross-agent instructions, English engineering policy and explicit origin history-fallback gaps.
gates.acceptance_proof: After separate authorization, each canonical app repo includes accurate machine-checkable matrices and Claude/DeepSeek routing docs with links to actual app source/test SHA; JSON schema/path validations pass without touching working runtime defaults.
gates.approval_required_for: Committing new developer files to active Flight repo or three empty destinations; changing repository ownership, source exports or release docs.
